fact: ZIMRA states taxpayers register online through its TaRMS Self-Service Portal, where a Taxpayer Identification Number is allocated once an official approves the application.
ZIMRA Public Notice 75 of 2024 says taxpayers are held in TaRMS under a Taxpayer Identity Number (TIN) that banks validate against payments, with tax clearance certificates issued automatically.
ZIMRA says TaRMS Taxpayer Registration launched on 12 October 2023 and 103,859 taxpayers had registered by early 2024 (36,745 new, 67,114 on-boarded).
